description: Feuerwehrstandorte (Gemeinde Diekholzen) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The fire brigade is an aid organisation with the task of providing assistance in the event of fires, accidents, floods and similar events, i.e. saving, protecting and recovering people, animals and property, with human rescue as the top priority. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Fire brigade locations (Municipality of Diekholzen)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
